# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML tags:
<tools>
{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "fetch_url", "description": "Fetch a web page and return its text content.", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"url": {"type": "string", "description": "The full URL to fetch."}}, "required": ["url"]}}}
</tools>

For each function call, return a json object with function name and arguments within <tool_call></tool_call> XML tags:
<tool_call>
{"name": <function-name>, "arguments": <args-json-object>}
</tool_call>

steps.content: Both sellers, Ottervale Audio and Brackmoor Sound, offer the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 headphones at the same price of $129.00. They both provide a 30-day return policy, a 1-year limited warranty, and similar product details such as battery life, Bluetooth version, and included accessories. However, Ottervale Audio mentions being an authorized Quellwyn dealer with a full manufacturer warranty, which might offer additional assurance and support. If you prioritize the manufacturer warranty, Ottervale Audio might be the better choice. Otherwise, both are reliable options, and the decision could come down to personal preference or seller reputation.
